title: Call of the Forest
description: A young boy's camaraderie with wild animals comes in handy when he sets out to avenge his father's death.

title: Stagecoach to Denver
description: Red Ryder uncovers a land-grabbing scheme engineered by a supposedly respected member of the community.

title: Hit the Saddle
description: The Three Mesquiteers (Robert Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) discover a painted horse and a fandango dancer.

title: Young Bill Hickok
description: The frontier hero (Roy Rogers) sings and saves Civil War gold with his sidekick (George "Gabby" Hayes).

title: 'Neath Canadian Skies
description: A Mountie tracks mine robbers in the 1890s Canada.

title: Bells of San Angelo
description: A writer (Dale Evans) of cowboy novels saves herself and a border agent (Roy Rogers) with a trick from her latest book.

title: My Pal Trigger
description: Roy's horse-breeding plans are complicated by a gambler in this fictional account of Trigger's conception and birth.

title: Boots and Saddles
description: A singing ranch foreman and his sidekick convince a young British nobleman to keep, rather than sell, the ranch left to him by his late father.

title: Arizona Bound
description: The Rough Riders (Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, Raymond Hatton) team up to save a woman's stagecoach line from a Mesa City saloon gang.

title: Wildfire
description: Two horse-traders (Bob Steele, Sterling Holloway) find their problem is a rustler (John Miljan), not a wild horse.

title: Kentucky Rifle
description: Stranded settlers (Chill Wills, Lance Fuller, Cathy Downs) enter hostile territory with a wagonload of rifles.

title: Buffalo Stampede
description: Buffalo hide trader Tom Doan must track down and outsmart a gang of white thieves disguised as raiding American Indians to save the woman he loves.

title: The Way of the West
description: A Mountie moves to a town and begins to stop its illegal activity by busting people one by one.

title: Hurricane Horseman
description: A gunsmith (Lane Chandler) offers to fix outlaws' guns if they release their hostage to him.

title: The Trail Beyond
description: Rod Drew (John Wayne) is asked to search for missing people in Canada, and quickly finds out a gang of French Canadian outlaws have been kidnapping people.

title: The Lucky Texan
description: Jerry Mason (John Wayne) and his friend Jake (George Hayes) have to keep two crooks away from their gold.

title: The Light of Western Stars
description: A Boston socialite (Jo Ann Sayers) attracts a ruffian (Victor Jory) along the Mexican border circa 1915.

title: High Lonesome
description: Texas ranchers blame a homeless drifter (John Barrymore Jr.) for two killers' dirty work.

title: Rage at Dawn
description: A special agent (Randolph Scott) poses as a train robber to infiltrate Frank Reno's (Forrest Tucker) outlaw gang.

title: Raiders of Old California
description: After the war with Mexico, cavalry officers try to steal land from Mexican peasants to establish their own empire.

title: Brothers of the West
description: Detective Tom Wade (Tom Tyler) has to investigate the truth behind a robbery and murder of a bank president that's being blamed on Tom's brother, Ed (Bob Terry), who is nowhere to be found.

title: The Fighting Redhead
description: Red Ryder helps his old friend Dan O'Connor in his fight against Faro Savage and his gang of rustlers.

title: Rawhide Rangers
description: An ex-lawman infiltrates an outlaw gang to avenge the death of his brother.

title: Born to Battle
description: Cattlemen offer a jailed cowboy his freedom if he will agree to help locate a gang of notorious rustlers.

title: Gunsmoke Ranch
description: The Three Mesquiteers (Bob Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) stop a land swindler out to profit from a flood.

title: Robin Hood of the Pecos
description: A night rider (George "Gabby" Hayes) and his singing partner (Roy Rogers) send Texas carpetbaggers packing.

title: New Mexico
description: After the Civil War, cavalryman Capt. Hunt tries to strike peace with Acoma, a Native American chief. However, Judge Wilcox and others provoke Acoma, arresting him and shooting his men, prompting revenge from the chief.

title: Song of Arizona
description: A youth from Gabby Whittaker's (George "Gabby" Hayes) Half-a-Chance Ranch for boys from troubled homes becomes a pawn in the fight between his late father's gang and Roy Rogers.

title: Hands Across the Border
description: A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) helps a slain rancher's daughter (Ruth Terry) breed horses for the Army.

title: Public Cowboy, No. 1
description: Modern-day cattle rustlers use a radio, airplanes and refrigerator trucks to expedite their illegal schemes.

title: Captain Apache
description: A full-blooded Apache working for the U.S. Army investigates a colleague's murder and uncovers a plot by a wealthy white farmer to instigate an Indian war; gunplay and bloodshed follow as the investigation deepens.

title: Mohawk
description: A barmaid, a Bostonian and an Indian (Rita Gam) flirt with an artist (Scott Brady) in 18th-century upstate New York.

title: Heartland
description: A Denver widow (Conchata Ferrell) with a daughter becomes a Scottish rancher's (Rip Torn) housekeeper in 1910 Wyoming.

title: Riders of Destiny
description: Agent Saunders (John Wayne) becomes partners with Fay (Cecelia Parker) to help her fight off a gang run by a local land grabber.

title: The Star Packer
description: Marshal John Travers investigates the murder of a town's sheriff, makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down a bandit called the Shadow.

title: One-Eyed Jacks
description: An ex-convict bandit (Marlon Brando) finds the partner (Karl Malden) who betrayed him is now a town sheriff with a wife (Katy Jurado) and daughter.

title: Vengeance Valley
description: A rancher's son (Robert Walker) gets his foster brother (Burt Lancaster) in trouble with an unwed mother's brothers.

title: Riders of the Deadline
description: Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) and his pals (Andy Clyde, Jimmy Rogers) get the drop on Mexican-border gunrunners.

title: The Gunman From Bodie
description: The Rough Riders (Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, Raymond Hatton) act like strangers to catch a crooked lawyer.

title: Ride, Ryder, Ride!
description: In their first cinematic outing, Red Ryder and his Indian sidekick help a newspaper publisher clean up her town.

title: Fighting Fury
description: A boy raised by his servant vows to take revenge on the ranchers who killed his parents.

title: With Sitting Bull at the Spirit Lake Massacre
description: Chief Sitting Bull surveys the settlement at Spirit Lake from afar and vows to retake the land that once belonged to his forefathers.

description:

description:

description:

description:

description:

description:

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S01 E12 — Annie and the Lily Maid
Annie becomes suspicious of Elaine Forbes, the seemingly innocent niece of a recently deceased rancher.

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S01 E13 — The Hardrock Trail
Outlaw Vic Carver (Robert B. Williams) seeks revenge against Sheriff MacTavish (Kenneth MacDonald) for sending him to jail.

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S01 E15 — Justice Guns
Annie (Gail Davis) races to save her retired mentor (Stanley Andrews) from a suicide mission with a merciless young gunman. With Ric Vallin.

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S01 E23 — Sharpshooting Annie
Annie and Tagg (Gail Davis, Jimmy Hawkins) track a masked bandit who holds up an acrobatic troupe. With Brad Johnson.

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S01 E24 — Annie Makes a Marriage
Annie (Gail Davis) plays matchmaker for her friend Bess Murdock (Nancy Hale). With Don Kennedy, Brad Johnson.

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S01 E25 — Outlaw Mesa
Annie relies on Tagg's ability as a ventriloquist to save an innocent stage driver from angry townspeople.

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S02 E03 — The Runaways
Tagg (Jimmy Hawkins) and his friend Billy (Stuffy Singer) run away to a ghost town inhabited by an outlaw gang. With Gail Davis.

title: Yellowneck
description: A sergeant (Lin McCarthy), a colonel (Stephen Courtleigh), a thief (Berry Kroeger) and two other Rebel deserters trek toward Cuba through the Everglades.

title: Custer's Last Stand
description: The search for a missing medicine arrow sparks a series of Indian attacks. Feature version of the serial.

title: West of the Divide
description: Ted and Dusty infiltrate a band of outlaws to get close to Mr. Gentry, the man who murdered Ted's father.

title: Randy Rides Alone
description: Government agent Randy Bowers (John Wayne) is accused of shooting up a saloon and has to escape from the jail to find the man behind the murders.

title: Daughter of the West
description: A convent-raised woman (Martha Vickers) learns of her American Indian heritage through romance with an educated Navajo (Philip Reed) during the 1880s.

title: American Empire
description: Three men (Richard Dix, Leo Carrillo, Preston Foster) start a big cattle ranch in post-Civil War Texas, but greed destroys it.

title: The Legend of the Lone Ranger
description: When the Butch Cavendish gang ambushes a group of Texas Rangers, the only surviving ranger dons a mask to protect his identity and swears to bring them to justice.

title: Adventures of Gallant Bess
description: A rodeo stunt rider (Cameron Mitchell) meets a woman (Audrey Long) who comes between him and his trick horse, Bess.

title: The Two-Gun Man
description: A cowboy (Ken Maynard) rousts rustlers and woos a blonde (Lucille Powers) on the range.

title: Fugitive of the Plains
description: Billy the Kid (Buster Crabbe) stages a shootout with outlaws who have transformed an innocent young lady into a wanted desperado.

title: Revenge of the Virgins
description: When white settlers start to move in on their sacred grounds, a tribe of female Indians vow to do anything they can to stop them.

title: Broadway to Cheyenne
description: A New York police officer, shot and wounded by a gangster, travels to Cheyenne, Wyo., to recuperate at his family's ranch, and is surprised to find a bootlegger from New York running a speakeasy there.

title: 'Neath Canadian Skies
description: A Mountie tracks mine robbers in the 1890s Canada.

description:

description:

Uncle Joe convinces two overweight women that the Shady Rest is really a reducing farm, where their loss is management's gain.

Railroad executive Homer Bedloe arrives in Hooterville with a railroad tycoon, who is determined to purchase the Cannonball.

A man travels to Hooterville to investigate a line connection.

Kate wants to hide the Hooterville Cannonball to save it from the scrap heap.

description:
S01 E13 — Letty Leaves Home
A couple of con men attempt to lure Letty into their scheme and get her to go to San Francisco.

description:
S01 E39 — Lone Star Killer
A Texas Ranger is shot down in cold blood and Judge and Jeff are determined to break the case.

description:

Judge Roy along with Taggart are intrigued by the arrival of Pat O'Hara and much younger wife Kate; Pat's fondness for drink and gambling has him involved with the town's rowdies.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E14 — Murder in Langtry
Deputy Jeff Taggart is framed in the murder of a horse trader.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E24 — Outlaw's Son
Judge Bean appoints himself as the legal guardian of a young man whose father was a member of an outlaw gang; the boy's uncle puts a bounty on his head.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E25 — The Reformer
Judge Bean's decisions displease some people, like prohibitionist Dolly Mason; she backs opposing candidate Duke Castle, an outlaw who claims he's reformed.

description:

A young boy runs away from home because his father doesn't stand up to his abusive boss.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E07 — Slightly Prodigal
A woman arrives in town looking for her son; Roy finds out that her son is not only in the area, but has become a notorious outlaw.

title: Daniel Boone, Trail Blazer
description: The frontiersman (Bruce Bennett) leads settlers to Kentucky, where he makes peace with a Shawnee chief (Lon Chaney).
